title: "test-raster"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# Load the raster library
library(raster)

# Create a sample raster with 3 distinct classes (strata)
r <- raster(ncol=10, nrow=10) # 100 cells total
values(r) <- round(runif(ncell(r), 1, 3)) # Assign integer values 1, 2, or 3 as strata

# Take a stratified random sample of 5 cells from *each* stratum
# xy = TRUE returns coordinates
smp <- sampleStratified(x = r, size = 5, exp=TRUE)

# View the results
# The output is a matrix where the first column is the stratum value, 
# and the next two columns are x and y coordinates.
head(smp) 
#       layer x y
# [1,]     1 0 5
# [2,]     1 0 6
# [3,]     1 1 5
# [4,]     1 2 6
# [5,]     1 2 7
# [6,]     2 0 4

# Check the number of samples per stratum
table(smp[,2]) 
#  1  2  3 
#  5  5  5 

# test extraction from r
rex <- raster::extract(r, smp[11:14,1])
print(rex)
```
